eligibility.rule: Any model already in the ZBook-local catalog or one of the three explicitly authorized downloads may compete if the ZBook can serve it without using a linked host.
download_allowlist: openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.6-gguf MiniCPM-V-4_6-F16.gguf with matching F16 mmproj

selection_rule.baseline: Retain the incumbent unless a challenger clears every switch condition.
switch_conditions: The challenger has at least four more exact labels correct out of 33 than the incumbent.
The challenger has fewer correct labels than the incumbent on no more than two of the eleven roles.
The challenger passes the runtime gate.
multiple_qualifying_challengers: Choose the greatest exact-label advantage over the incumbent.
Then choose the most roles with three of three correct.
Then choose the most roles with at least two of three correct.
If still tied, retain the smaller complete runtime artifact.
selection_rule.interpretation: This pilot selects one local arm. It is not evidence that a role is recoverable; only the frozen 200-unit per-role evaluation answers that question.
